modelGuidance:
Luna (openai/gpt-6-luna): explicit-input extraction, classification, and mechanical supporting work with checkable outputs.
Terra (openai/gpt-6.1-terra): scoped implementation, debugging, writing, and focused review against settled requirements; ordinary local judgment is expected.
Inherit the parent model for consequential interacting uncertainties, unsettled architecture, or broad synthesis.
Choose the role separately from the model. Task size alone does not determine model choice. Preserve acceptance checks regardless of model.
Strategists always use the actual parent model; model overrides and template model defaults cannot change that. Thinking is a separate choice.
